exposure: maternal COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy (at least one dose of messenger RNA COVID-19 vaccine)
cohort: The study included 140,073 singleton pregnancies in Quebec, Canada, resulting in a live birth or stillbirth at >=20 weeks of gestation.
finding: COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of adverse outcomes, and was associated with a reduced risk of several adverse outcomes including preterm birth, SGA, and maternal/neonatal ICU admission.
mod_finding: Vaccination during pregnancy was significantly associated with a reduced risk of caesarean delivery.
